items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S3277

SPONSOR: SKOUFIS
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the agriculture and markets law, in relation to estab-
lishing a process for designating transfer-on-death beneficiaries for
farming implements

 
PURPOSE:

To establish a process called 'transfer-on-death beneficiaries' for
transferral of farm implements upon the owner's death.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Article 30 and several sections (550 to 555) of the agricul-
ture and markets law are renumbered as Article 50 and sections 1000 to
1005, respectively.

Section 2: Adds a new Article 30, 'Transfer-on-Death of Farming Imple-
ments.' Introduces the concept of a 'Transfer-on-death beneficiary,' a
person designated to receive farm implements upon the owner's death.
Specifies the process for designating a 'transfer-on-death beneficiary,'
including the required document filing with the commissioner.

Section 3: Sets Effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

This bill ensures a smoother transition of ownership of farm implements,
simplifies administrative tasks, and reduces the need for potentially
timely and costly probate.

 
LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:

Senate

2023: N/A

2024: S8425, Advanced to Third Reading

Assembly

2023: N/A

2024: A10433, Referred to Agriculture

 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

None.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect on the first of January next succeeding the
date on which it shall have become a law. Effective immediately, the
addition, amendment and/or repeal of any rule or regulation necessary
for the implementation of this act on its effective date are authorized
to be made and completed on or before such effective date.

summary: Establishes a process for designating transfer-on-death beneficiaries for farming implements involving filing a document with the commissioner of agriculture and markets.
